incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx rate in eu-west-2 (az-a) detected by global-5xx-rate (avg 6m window) > 3% :rotating_light:
Aisha (oncall): seeing it. pages went out. grabbing quick triage.
Aisha (oncall): initial symptoms: spikes at gateway -> 502/504, upstream connection resets, latency jump to 1.2s p95 for routed requests to eu-west-2.
Marco (eng-sre): can you paste the first failure logs?
Aisha (oncall): pasting sample from gateway logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:02:09Z] gw-proxy-eu-a - upstream_status=502 up_err=connection_reset by peer id=abcd1234 route=eu-west-2
[2026-03-15T12:02:10Z] gw-proxy-eu-a - upstream_status=502 up_err=connection_reset by peer id=abcd1234 route=eu-west-2
```
Priya (eng-runtime): kv-worker and model workers in eu-west-2 az-a show increased 5xx from grpc timeouts in the ML pool. Per-host CPU and socket stats look normal.
Aisha (oncall): Prom query (PromQL): `sum(rate(gateway_response_codes{region=\"eu-west-2\",code=~\"5..\"}[1m])) by (az)` -> shows az-a at ~150 req/min 5xx, az-b/c < 5/min.
Marco (eng-sre): sounds like an AZ-local upstream issue. Are hosts networking healthy? `ss -s` and conntrack?
Aisha (oncall): conntrack at host level is high on a few proxy boxes:
```
# conntrack -S | grep entries
entries 2200000
```
Aisha (oncall): we usually alarm at 2.5M; but several boxes in az-a are at 90% of conntrack table. could be NAT exhaustion at the AZ egress NAT.
Sam (support): we have ~7 customer reports with errors in eu-west today, some pinned to eu-west for data locality.
Leah (product-ops): list of pinned tenants? we need customer-impact summary for comms.
Aisha (oncall): compiling public impacted orgs: org-omega, org-lumen (low-volume), org-harbor (batch jobs). Noting org-harbor runs long-polling requests that amplify NAT usage.
Marco (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) reduce per-host conntrack usage (short term) 2) shift percentage traffic off eu-west-2 to eu-west-1/3 (where allowed) 3) bring up additional NAT capacity or restart offending NAT hosts (risk: in-flight connections).
Priya (eng-runtime): runtime suggestion: enable fallback routing for tenant-affine requests to allow cross-region reads for non-sensitive payloads. This is per-tenant opt-in; need product ops signoff.
Leah (product-ops): for org-omega and org-lumen we can failover non-sensitive endpoints. org-harbor needs consent; contacting their SRE.
Marco (eng-sre): quick safe mitigations: a) increase gateway circuit-breaker to tolerate retry storms (set threshold +10% for 30m) b) enable short-circuit caching for long-poll endpoints to reduce system calls c) scale pool of gateway workers in az-b/c to accept rerouted traffic.
Aisha (oncall): executing short mitigations now:
- running `redwoodctl infra conntrack-increase --hosts gw-eu-a --slab 524288` (rolling)
- running `redwoodctl route-weight set --region eu-west-2 --weight 60` (reduce by 40% -> routes go to eu-west-1/3)
CICD-Bot: deploy started: route-weight-change v1.2 by Aisha (oncall).
Aisha (oncall): checking curl test to routed backend:
```bash
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null 'https://api.redwood.dev/generate?region=eu-west-2' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'
```
Aisha (oncall): before change 502; after change partial routing -> responses successful from eu-west-1. p95 latency for rerouted requests ~420ms.
Marco (eng-sre): adding temporary iptables rules to reduce TIME_WAIT retention on workers (reduces conntrack entries). rolling across 3 boxes first.
Priya (eng-runtime): I see a model-worker in eu-west-2 az-a repeatedly failing grpc accepts: `ERROR grpc: accept tcp 10.31.4.19:50051: accept: too many open files` - file descriptors spike. Likely due to connection churn + long-poll.
Marco (eng-sre): file-descriptor bump is orthogonal; can we restart the problematic worker process after draining?
Priya (eng-runtime): scheduling drain now. adding to drain list: mw-eu-a-07, mw-eu-a-09.
Sam (support): customer comms draft for org-omega/org-lumen: "We are experiencing elevated errors in eu-west-2; we have rerouted traffic and expect reduced error rates. We'll update in 30m." Approve?
Leah (product-ops): approve for org-omega/org-lumen. org-harbor hold until SRE confirms safe fallback.
Marco (eng-sre): monitoring: set temporary alert `eu-west-2-5xx > 1% for 5m` and watch. Also create synthetic probe to measure failover success.
Aisha (oncall): alert suppression on the flapping alarms for the next 45m to avoid noise.
Priya (eng-runtime): drain done on mw-eu-a-07, restart worker, rejoin pool. fd usage now stable.
Aisha (oncall): conntrack/test metrics improving: eu-west-2 5xx now down from 3.6% -> 0.9% in 15m window. traffic weight shift holding.
CICD-Bot: route-weight-change v1.2 completed (applied by Aisha).
Marco (eng-sre): short post-action items: - confirm NAT host health and increase pool next maintenance - add conntrack autoscaling runbook - long-term: improve per-client connection reuse and adaptive keepalive.
Leah (product-ops): customer comms: "We mitigated a localized gateway issue in eu-west-2 by rerouting a portion of traffic and restarting affected workers. Some customers with pinned geography experienced temporary errors. We're tracking follow-up items and will share a detailed postmortem."
Sam (support): sending message to impacted customers now.
Aisha (oncall): handing off to Marco for night coverage. Handoff checklist:
- what happened: NAT/conntrack exhaustion + fd leak on model workers in az-a caused 5xx spike
- what we changed: reduced route weight to eu-west-2 by 40%, drained & restarted failing workers, adjusted ufw/iptables TIME_WAIT retention, increased conntrack slab on problematic hosts
- monitoring to watch: eu-west-2 5xx_rate, gw_latency_p95, conntrack_entries per host, worker_fd_usage
- contact points: Marco (eng-sre) + Priya (eng-runtime) + Leah (product-ops)
Marco (eng-sre): taking over. will keep the route at reduced weight for 2 hours then reassess. initiating NAT capacity scale playbook.
Aisha (oncall): leaving notes in incident channel and oncall doc. moving to post-incident follow-up.
Marco (eng-sre): ETA for restore to full weight: dependent on NAT capacity increase and tenant approvals for failover (org-harbor). target: 2-3 hours.
Leah (product-ops): opened ticket for product-ops to reach out org-harbor SRE.
Priya (eng-runtime): creating follow-up JIRA: RUNTIME-1427 "Improve socket reuse & conntrack autoscaling"
Sam (support): closing customer support cases with note: "service degraded briefly, traffic rerouted; please re-open if you see persistent errors."
Marco (eng-sre): leaving a short timeline for the postmortem: root cause analysis in 48h, include telemetry, configs, and action items. tagging postmortem owner: Priya.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 5xx rate returned below threshold in eu-west-2 (az-a) and routing normalized. Marking task complete on active mitigation.
Aisha (oncall): thanks team.
Leah (product-ops): thanks all.
Marco (eng-sre): handoff complete.
